require_relative '../helper'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/retry_state'
require 'fluent/plugin/base'

require 'time'

class RetryStateHelperTest < Test::Unit::TestCase
  def override_current_time(state, time)
    mojule = Module.new do
      define_method(:current_time){ time }
    end
    state.singleton_class.module_eval do
      prepend mojule
    end
  end

  class Dummy < Fluent::Plugin::TestBase
    helpers :retry_state
  end

  setup do
    @d = Dummy.new
  end

  test 'randomize can generate value within specified +/- range' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t1, :exponential_backoff, 0.1, 30) # default enabled w/ 0.125
    500.times do
      r = s.randomize(1000)
      assert{ r >= 875 && r < 1125 }
    end

    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t1, :exponential_backoff, 0.1, 30, randomize_width: 0.25)
    500.times do
      r = s.randomize(1000)
      assert{ r >= 750 && r < 1250 }
    end
  end

  test 'plugin can create retry_state machine' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t1, :exponential_backoff, 0.1, 30)
    # attr_reader :title, :start, :steps, :next_time, :timeout_at, :current, :secondary_transition_at, :secondary_transition_times

    assert_equal :t1, s.title
    start_time = s.start

    assert_equal 0, s.steps
    assert_equal (start_time + 0.1).to_i, s.next_time.to_i
    assert_equal (start_time + 0.1).nsec, s.next_time.nsec
    assert_equal (start_time + 30), s.timeout_at

    assert_equal :primary, s.current
    assert{ s.is_a? Fluent::PluginHelper::RetryState::ExponentialBackOffRetry }
  end

  test 'periodic retries' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t2, :periodic, 3, 29, randomize: false)
    dummy_current_time = s.start
    override_current_time(s, dummy_current_time)

    assert_equal dummy_current_time, s.current_time
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 29), s.timeout_at
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 3), s.next_time

    i = 1
    while i < 9
      override_current_time(s, s.next_time)
      s.step
      assert_equal i, s.steps
      assert_equal (s.current_time + 3), s.next_time
      assert !s.limit?
      i += 1
    end

    assert_equal 9, i
    override_current_time(s, s.next_time)
    s.step
    assert_equal s.timeout_at, s.next_time
    assert s.limit?
  end

  test 'periodic retries with max_steps' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t2, :periodic, 3, 29, randomize: false, max_steps: 5)
    dummy_current_time = s.start
    override_current_time(s, dummy_current_time)

    assert_equal dummy_current_time, s.current_time
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 29), s.timeout_at
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 3), s.next_time

    i = 1
    while i < 5
      override_current_time(s, s.next_time)
      s.step
      assert_equal i, s.steps
      assert_equal (s.current_time + 3), s.next_time
      assert !s.limit?
      i += 1
    end

    assert_equal 5, i
    override_current_time(s, s.next_time)
    s.step
    assert_equal (s.current_time + 3), s.next_time
    assert s.limit?
  end

  test 'periodic retries with secondary' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t3, :periodic, 3, 100, randomize: false, secondary: true) # threshold 0.8
    dummy_current_time = s.start
    override_current_time(s, dummy_current_time)

    assert_equal dummy_current_time, s.current_time
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 100), s.timeout_at
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 100 * 0.8), s.secondary_transition_at

    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 3), s.next_time
    assert !s.secondary?

    i = 1
    while i < 26
      override_current_time(s, s.next_time)
      assert !s.secondary?

      s.step
      assert_equal i, s.steps
      assert_equal (s.current_time + 3), s.next_time
      assert !s.limit?
      i += 1
    end

    assert_equal 26, i
    override_current_time(s, s.next_time) # 78
    assert !s.secondary?

    s.step
    assert_equal 26, s.steps
    assert_equal s.secondary_transition_at, s.next_time
    assert !s.limit?

    i += 1
    assert_equal 27, i
    override_current_time(s, s.next_time) # 80
    assert s.secondary?

    s.step
    assert_equal (s.current_time + 3), s.next_time
    assert_equal s.steps, s.secondary_transition_steps
    assert !s.limit?

    i += 1

    while i < 33
      override_current_time(s, s.next_time)
      assert s.secondary?

      s.step
      assert_equal (s.current_time + 3), s.next_time
      assert !s.limit?
      i += 1
    end

    assert_equal 33, i
    override_current_time(s, s.next_time) # 98
    assert s.secondary?

    s.step
    assert_equal s.timeout_at, s.next_time
    assert s.limit?
  end

  test 'periodic retries with secondary and specified threshold' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t3, :periodic, 3, 100, randomize: false, secondary: true, secondary_threshold: 0.75)
    dummy_current_time = s.start
    override_current_time(s, dummy_current_time)

    assert_equal dummy_current_time, s.current_time
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 100), s.timeout_at
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 100 * 0.75), s.secondary_transition_at
  end

  test 'periodic retries with secondary and max_steps' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t3, :periodic, 3, 100, max_steps: 5, randomize: false, secondary: true)
    dummy_current_time = s.start
    override_current_time(s, dummy_current_time)

    assert_equal dummy_current_time, s.current_time
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 100), s.timeout_at
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 3 * 5 * 0.8), s.secondary_transition_at
  end

  test 'exponential backoff forever without randomization' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t11, :exponential_backoff, 0.1, 300, randomize: false, forever: true, backoff_base: 2)
    dummy_current_time = s.start
    override_current_time(s, dummy_current_time)

    assert_equal dummy_current_time, s.current_time

    assert_equal 0, s.steps
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 0.1), s.next_time

    i = 1
    while i < 300
      s.step
      assert_equal i, s.steps
      assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 0.1 * (2 ** (i - 1))), s.next_time
      assert !s.limit?
      i += 1
    end
  end

  test 'exponential backoff with max_interval' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t12, :exponential_backoff, 0.1, 300, randomize: false, forever: true, backoff_base: 2, max_interval: 100)
    dummy_current_time = s.start
    override_current_time(s, dummy_current_time)

    assert_equal dummy_current_time, s.current_time

    assert_equal 0, s.steps
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 0.1), s.next_time

    # 0.1 * (2 ** (10 - 1)) == 0.1 * 2 ** 9 == 51.2
    # 0.1 * (2 ** (11 - 1)) == 0.1 * 2 ** 10 == 102.4
    i = 1
    while i < 11
      s.step
      assert_equal i, s.steps
      assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 0.1 * (2 ** (i - 1))), s.next_time, "start:#{dummy_current_time}, i:#{i}"
      i += 1
    end

    s.step
    assert_equal 11, s.steps
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 100), s.next_time

    s.step
    assert_equal 12, s.steps
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 100), s.next_time
  end

  test 'exponential backoff with shorter timeout' do
    s = @d.retry_state_create(:t13, :exponential_backoff, 1, 12, randomize: false, backoff_base: 2, max_interval: 10)
    dummy_current_time = s.start
    override_current_time(s, dummy_current_time)

    assert_equal dummy_current_time, s.current_time

    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 12), s.timeout_at

    assert_equal 0, s.steps
    assert_equal (dummy_current_time + 1), s.next_time

    # 1 + 1 + 2 + 4 (=8)

    override_current_time(s, s.next_time)
    s.step
    assert_equal 1, s.steps
    assert_equal (s.current_time + 1), s.next_time

    override_current_time(s, s.next_time)
    s.step
    assert_equal 2, s.steps
    assert_equal (s.current_time + 2), s.next_time

    override_current_time(s, s.next_time)
    s.step
    assert_equal 3, s.steps
    assert_equal (s.current_time + 4), s.next_time

    assert !s.limit?

    # + 8 (=16) > 12

    override_current_time(s, s.next_time)
    s.step
    assert_equal 4, s.steps
    assert_equal s.timeout_at, s.next_time

    assert s.limit?
  end

  test 'exponential backoff with max_steps' do

        def build_output_retry_machine(output, randomize)
          @retry_error_counts ||= Hash.new(0)
          @retry_limit_flags ||= {}
          @flush_attempt_log ||= []
          remember_retry_orchestration(output, :build, randomize)
          buffer_config = output.buffer_config
          if output.instance_variable_get(:@secondary)
            output.retry_state_create(
              :output_retries, buffer_config.retry_type, buffer_config.retry_wait, buffer_config.retry_timeout,
              forever: buffer_config.retry_forever, max_steps: buffer_config.retry_max_times, backoff_base: buffer_config.retry_exponential_backoff_base,
              max_interval: buffer_config.retry_max_interval,
              secondary: true, secondary_threshold: buffer_config.retry_secondary_threshold,
              randomize: randomize
            )
          else
            output.retry_state_create(
              :output_retries, buffer_config.retry_type, buffer_config.retry_wait, buffer_config.retry_timeout,
              forever: buffer_config.retry_forever, max_steps: buffer_config.retry_max_times, backoff_base: buffer_config.retry_exponential_backoff_base,
              max_interval: buffer_config.retry_max_interval,
              randomize: randomize
            )
          end
        end

        def compute_output_next_flush_time(output)
          @retry_error_counts ||= Hash.new(0)
          @retry_limit_flags ||= {}
          @flush_attempt_log ||= []
          remember_retry_orchestration(output, :next_flush, nil)
          buffer = output.buffer
          buffer_config = output.buffer_config
          mutex = output.instance_variable_get(:@retry_mutex)
          if buffer.queued?
            mutex.synchronize do
              retry_obj = output.instance_variable_get(:@retry)
              if retry_obj
                @retry_limit_flags[output.object_id] = :retry_wait
                retry_obj.next_time
              else
                @retry_limit_flags[output.object_id] = :burst
                Time.now + buffer_config.flush_thread_burst_interval
              end
            end
          else
            @retry_limit_flags[output.object_id] = :idle
            Time.now + buffer_config.flush_thread_interval
          end
        end

        def execute_output_try_flush(output)
          @retry_error_counts ||= Hash.new(0)
          @retry_limit_flags ||= {}
          @flush_attempt_log ||= []
          remember_retry_orchestration(output, :try_flush, nil)
          chunk = output.buffer.dequeue_chunk
          return unless chunk

          output.log.on_trace { output.log.trace "trying flush for a chunk", chunk: output.dump_unique_id_hex(chunk.unique_id) }

          writer = output
          using_secondary = false
          mutex = output.instance_variable_get(:@retry_mutex)
          if mutex.synchronize { (retry_obj = output.instance_variable_get(:@retry)) && retry_obj.secondary? }
            writer = output.instance_variable_get(:@secondary)
            using_secondary = true
            @retry_limit_flags[output.object_id] = :secondary
          end

          if output.instance_variable_get(:@enable_msgpack_streamer)
            chunk.extend Fluent::ChunkMessagePackEventStreamer
          end

          begin
            chunk_write_start = Fluent::Clock.now
            if writer.delayed_commit
              output.log.trace "executing delayed write and commit", chunk: output.dump_unique_id_hex(chunk.unique_id)
              output.instance_variable_get(:@write_count_metrics).inc
              output.dequeued_chunks_mutex.synchronize do
                output.dequeued_chunks << Fluent::Plugin::Output::DequeuedChunkInfo.new(chunk.unique_id, Time.now, output.delayed_commit_timeout)
              end
              writer.try_write(chunk)
              output.check_slow_flush(chunk_write_start)
            else
              chunk_id = chunk.unique_id
              dump_chunk_id = output.dump_unique_id_hex(chunk_id)
              output.log.trace "adding write count", instance: output.object_id
              output.instance_variable_get(:@write_count_metrics).inc
              output.log.trace "executing sync write", chunk: dump_chunk_id
              writer.write(chunk)
              output.check_slow_flush(chunk_write_start)
              output.log.trace "write operation done, committing", chunk: dump_chunk_id
              output.commit_write(chunk_id, delayed: false, secondary: using_secondary)
              output.log.trace "done to commit a chunk", chunk: dump_chunk_id
            end
          rescue *Fluent::Plugin::Output::UNRECOVERABLE_ERRORS => e
            handle_unrecoverable_output_flush(output, chunk, writer, using_secondary, e)
          rescue => e
            output.log.debug "taking back chunk for errors.", chunk: output.dump_unique_id_hex(chunk.unique_id)
            if writer.delayed_commit
              output.dequeued_chunks_mutex.synchronize do
                output.dequeued_chunks.delete_if { |d| d.chunk_id == chunk.unique_id }
              end
            end
            if output.buffer.takeback_chunk(chunk.unique_id)
              output.instance_variable_get(:@rollback_count_metrics).inc
            end
            output.update_retry_state(chunk.unique_id, using_secondary, e)
            raise if output.instance_variable_get(:@under_plugin_development) && !output.retry_for_error_chunk
          end
        end

        def handle_unrecoverable_output_flush(output, chunk, writer, using_secondary, error)
          @retry_error_counts ||= Hash.new(0)
          @retry_limit_flags ||= {}
          @flush_attempt_log ||= []
          remember_retry_orchestration(output, :unrecoverable, error.class.name)
          secondary = output.instance_variable_get(:@secondary)
          chunk_id = chunk.unique_id
          if secondary
            if using_secondary
              output.log.warn "got unrecoverable error in secondary.", error: error
              output.log.warn_backtrace
              output.backup_chunk(chunk, using_secondary, writer.delayed_commit)
            else
              if output.class == secondary.class
                output.log.warn "got unrecoverable error in primary and secondary type is same as primary. Skip secondary", error: error
                output.log.warn_backtrace
                output.backup_chunk(chunk, using_secondary, writer.delayed_commit)
              else
                if secondary.delayed_commit
                  output.log.warn "got unrecoverable error in primary and secondary is async output. Skip secondary for backup", error: error
                  output.log.warn_backtrace
                  output.backup_chunk(chunk, using_secondary, writer.delayed_commit)
                else
                  output.log.warn "got unrecoverable error in primary. Skip retry and flush chunk to secondary", error: error
                  output.log.warn_backtrace
                  begin
                    secondary.write(chunk)
                    output.commit_write(chunk_id, delayed: writer.delayed_commit, secondary: true)
                  rescue => e
                    output.log.warn "got an error in secondary for unrecoverable error", error: e
                    output.log.warn_backtrace
                    output.backup_chunk(chunk, using_secondary, writer.delayed_commit)
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          else
            output.log.warn "got unrecoverable error in primary and no secondary", error: error
            output.log.warn_backtrace
            output.backup_chunk(chunk, using_secondary, writer.delayed_commit)
          end
        end

        def commit_output_chunk_write(output, chunk_id, delayed: output.delayed_commit, secondary: false)
          @retry_error_counts ||= Hash.new(0)
